implementation_plan.overview: Create enhanced_bead_generator module with pure functions that extract EARS patterns, contract specifications, type definitions, and test cases from Behavior types. Build structured EnhancedBeadRecord type that provides rich implementation context for AI agents.

architectural_decisions.decision: Create new module instead of modifying bead_templates
architectural_decisions.rationale: Non-breaking change, allows existing workflow to continue, clear separation of concerns

architectural_decisions.decision: Define EnhancedBeadRecord as separate type from BeadRecord
architectural_decisions.rationale: BeadRecord is used in multiple places, changing it would require widespread updates. New type allows gradual adoption.

architectural_decisions.decision: Pure functions for all extraction logic
architectural_decisions.rationale: Testable, composable, follows Gleam 7 Commandments (immutability, no side effects)

architectural_decisions.decision: Use Result types for error handling
architectural_decisions.rationale: Railway-Oriented Programming, explicit error cases, no panics

new_files.purpose: Core module with types and extraction functions
Unit tests for enhanced bead generation

type_definitions.name: EarsPatternInfo
type_definitions.definition: EarsPatternInfo(pattern_type: String, trigger: Option(String), state: Option(String), condition: Option(String), behavior: String)
type_definitions.purpose: Simplified EARS pattern representation for beads (not full EarsRequirement)
type_definitions.rationale: BeadRecord needs string-serializable EARS info, not full parsing structure

type_definitions.name: BeadContracts
type_definitions.definition: BeadContracts(preconditions: List(String), postconditions: List(ContractCheck), invariants: List(String))

fields.invariants: System-wide constraints (extracted from global rules if available)

type_definitions.name: ContractCheck
type_definitions.definition: ContractCheck(rule: String, why: String, check_name: String)

type_definitions.name: TestCase
type_definitions.definition: TestCase(name: String, given: List(String), when: String, then: String, assertion: String)

fields.name: Descriptive test name from check name

type_definitions.name: TypeDefinition
type_definitions.definition: TypeDefinition(name: String, signature: String, purpose: String)

type_definitions.name: EnhancedBeadRecord
type_definitions.definition: EnhancedBeadRecord(base: BeadRecord, ears_patterns: List(EarsPatternInfo), contracts: BeadContracts, types: List(TypeDefinition), tests: List(TestCase))
type_definitions.purpose: Enriched bead with all AI implementation context
type_definitions.rationale: Composition over modification - wraps BeadRecord instead of replacing it

implementation_steps.details: Create EarsPatternInfo, BeadContracts, ContractCheck, TestCase, TypeDefinition, EnhancedBeadRecord types with proper exports

logic: Extract preconditions from behavior.requires list
Convert response.checks Dict to List(ContractCheck) for postconditions
For each check: ContractCheck(rule: check.rule, why: check.why, check_name: name)
Invariants empty for now (could be enhanced later with global rules)
Return BeadContracts
Parse intent string to detect EARS keywords
Match patterns: WHEN->EventDriven, WHILE->StateDriven, WHERE->Optional, SHALL NOT->Unwanted
Default to Ubiquitous if no keywords
Extract trigger/state/condition using string operations
Return list of EarsPatternInfo (typically 1 item, but behavior.intent might have multiple)
Handle parse failures gracefully - return Ubiquitous pattern with full intent as behavior
Analyze behavior.request.method and path to infer handler function
Extract request body type from behavior.request.body (if object)
Extract response type from behavior.response.example (if object)
Generate TypeDefinition for request handler: 'handle_<path>(request: Request) -> Response'
Generate TypeDefinition for request body type if present
Generate TypeDefinition for response body type if present
Return list of type definitions
For each check in behavior.response.checks:
Create TestCase(
name: check_name + ' validation',
given: behavior.requires (preconditions),
when: behavior.intent + ' with ' + method + ' ' + path,
then: Check.why,
assertion: Check.rule
Add base test case for status code check
Return list of test cases

implementation_steps.signature: fn generate_enhanced_bead(behavior: Behavior, profile_type: String) -> EnhancedBeadRecord
logic: Create base BeadRecord from behavior (similar to existing bead_templates logic)
Call extract_contracts_from_behavior(behavior) -> contracts
Call extract_ears_patterns(behavior.intent) -> ears_patterns
Call generate_type_definitions(behavior) -> types
Call generate_test_cases(behavior) -> tests
Return EnhancedBeadRecord(base, ears_patterns, contracts, types, tests)

implementation_steps.details: Implement to_json functions for EnhancedBeadRecord and all sub-types to enable --json output

test_cases.name: test_extract_contracts_with_multiple_checks
test_cases.purpose: Verify multiple response checks convert to postconditions correctly
test_cases.setup: Create Behavior with 3 checks in response.checks
test_cases.assertion: BeadContracts has 3 postconditions with correct rule/why

test_cases.name: test_extract_contracts_with_requires
test_cases.setup: Create Behavior with 2 items in requires list

test_cases.name: test_extract_ears_event_driven
test_cases.setup: Create behavior with intent 'WHEN user clicks submit THE SYSTEM SHALL validate form'
test_cases.assertion: EarsPatternInfo has pattern_type='EventDriven', trigger='user clicks submit', behavior='validate form'

test_cases.name: test_extract_ears_state_driven
test_cases.setup: Create behavior with intent 'WHILE user is authenticated THE SYSTEM SHALL show dashboard'
test_cases.assertion: EarsPatternInfo has pattern_type='StateDriven', state='user is authenticated'

test_cases.name: test_extract_ears_ubiquitous_fallback
test_cases.purpose: Verify default to Ubiquitous when no keywords
test_cases.setup: Create behavior with intent 'The system validates input'

test_cases.name: test_generate_type_definitions_post_request
test_cases.purpose: Verify type generation for POST with request body
test_cases.setup: Create POST behavior with JSON body in request
test_cases.assertion: TypeDefinition includes request body type and handler signature

test_cases.name: test_generate_test_cases_from_checks
test_cases.purpose: Verify each check becomes a test case

test_cases.name: test_generate_enhanced_bead_integration
test_cases.purpose: Verify full pipeline from Behavior to EnhancedBeadRecord
test_cases.setup: Create realistic behavior with intent, checks, requires
test_cases.assertion: EnhancedBeadRecord has all fields populated: ears_patterns, contracts, types, tests

test_data.sample_behavior: Create helper function make_test_behavior() that returns a realistic Behavior with method=POST, path='/users', intent with EARS pattern, 2 requires, 3 checks in response

edge_cases: Behavior with empty response.checks -> contracts has empty postconditions
Behavior with empty requires -> contracts has empty preconditions
Intent without EARS keywords -> defaults to Ubiquitous pattern
Request with no body -> types list omits request body type
Response example is null -> types list omits response body type
Behavior with complex nested JSON -> type generation handles recursion

gleam_conventions.immutability: All types immutable, no mutable state
gleam_conventions.no_nulls: Use Option(T) for optional fields, never null
gleam_conventions.pipelines: Use |> for data transformations (checks |> dict.to_list |> list.map)
gleam_conventions.exhaustive_matching: Pattern match on all cases (Option, Result, custom types)
gleam_conventions.labeled_args: Use labeled arguments for functions with 3+ params
gleam_conventions.type_safety: Leverage type system, avoid dynamic types where possible

success_criteria: All types defined with proper exports
Extract contracts function handles checks and requires
Extract EARS patterns function detects at least 3 pattern types
Generate type definitions function infers request/response types
Generate test cases function creates BDD-style scenarios
Main generate_enhanced_bead function composes all extractors
